content.title: G Q3 Deep Dive: Advanced Technology Solutions Fuel Growth, Margin Expansion
content.summary: Business transformation services company Genpact (NYSE:G) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 6.6% year on year to $1.29 billion.
